constraints: Raising the policy version can change NEW policy behavior; read the policies introduced between the old and new floor before committing.

steps.instructions: Change the reported cmake_minimum_required(VERSION …) so the effective policy version is at least 3.10 (for example VERSION 3.16, or VERSION 3.5...3.16).
steps.title: Raise the reported cmake_minimum_required policy version

verification.purpose: Configure with developer warnings enabled and confirm the policy-floor deprecation is gone.

rules.replacement: cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10) or newer, or VERSION <min>...<max> with <max> at least 3.10

sources.title: CMake 3.31 release notes (compatibility older than 3.10 deprecated)

rules.summary: CMake 3.31 deprecated compatibility with policy versions older than 3.10. A cmake_minimum_required(VERSION) or cmake_policy(VERSION) call that does not set the policy version to at least 3.10 (optionally via ...<policy_max>) produces a deprecation warning on CMake 3.31 and newer. CMake 3.31.0 was published on 2024-11-06. Versions older than 3.5 are covered by the removal rule instead.
rules.title: CMake policy versions older than 3.10 are deprecated

constraints: Raising the policy version can change NEW policy behavior; read the policies introduced between the old and new floor before committing.
Projects that must still configure on older CMake can use VERSION <min>...<max> so the minimum stays low while the policy max is at least 3.5 on newer CMake.

steps.instructions: Change the reported cmake_minimum_required(VERSION …) so the effective policy version is at least 3.5 (for example VERSION 3.16, or VERSION 2.8.12...3.16).
steps.title: Raise the reported cmake_minimum_required policy version

verification.purpose: Configure the project with a CMake 4.x toolchain and confirm the policy floor is accepted.

rules.replacement: cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5) or newer, or VERSION <min>...<max> with <max> at least 3.5

sources.title: CMake 4.0 release notes (compatibility older than 3.5 removed)

rules.summary: CMake 4.0 removed compatibility with policy versions older than 3.5. A cmake_minimum_required(VERSION) or cmake_policy(VERSION) call that does not set the policy version to at least 3.5 (optionally via ...<policy_max>) produces an error on CMake 4.0 and newer. CMake 4.0.0 was published on 2025-03-27.
rules.title: CMake policy versions older than 3.5 are removed
